items.title: How long do you think humans have left on this planet?
items.text: How long do you think humans have left on this planet?
I think you need to extend that minimum range now
Interesting. Maybe I should rephrase, how long do you think we have as a species growing in this manner? What happens when we reach 10 billion, 20 billion? How can we support a population so high?
I agree. Feels like the whole of humanity is ignoring the elephant in the room
Touché
Ok then be serious? What's your honest opinion
Are you referring to lack of resources, wars etc?
I hear EA just put some on sale. First purchase gets you through the gate, but you need a recurring subscription to stay
What do you think will cause the drop?
I agree with that general idea. There's a movie called "The Road" which I think may be an accurate portrayal of "post-apocalyptic" society
See I love it. I see it as a wake-up call. Obviously not all people believe that's the way we are moving, but it's definitely inspired myself and others to try and make a difference

I think medical technology will advance to the point that people will begin to live way past current life expectancy, and in turn that will cause bigger problems with overpopulation, which in turn causes capitalization. The rich will come out on top as always, and there will be a shift in demographics. The elite, and extreme poverty will be the only ones left

I think even if we accomplish technological feats that would allow us to do all you described, everywhere we inhabit will end the same way. The people in the position to do things like that are the same people who will capitalize on anything they can, which means we can never truly live in a utopia
